reviewNotes: Penny's complete eight-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English, preserving her clinic, shopping, work and quiet-rain contexts, with every control exact.

marriage_Mon.002.source: I wonder if Maru will get married some day?
marriage_Mon.002.translation: Mă întreb dacă Maru se va căsători într-o zi.

marriageJob.000.source: Hi, honey. It's nice of you to visit me at work.$h
marriageJob.000.translation: Bună, iubire. E drăguț din partea ta să mă vizitezi la lucru.$h

marriage_Mon.001.source: Don't worry, I'm using my own money to buy this.
marriage_Mon.001.translation: Nu-ți face griji, plătesc asta din banii mei.

marriage_Mon.000.source: Hi, honey! I'm just doing some shopping.
marriage_Mon.000.translation: Bună, iubire! Fac doar câteva cumpărături.

winter_15.000.source: Can you smell that? The air is so spicy here...
winter_15.000.translation: Simți mirosul? Aerul este atât de plin de mirodenii aici...

winter_4.000.source: I have an appointment at the clinic this afternoon.
winter_4.000.translation: Am programare la clinică în după-amiaza aceasta.

rain2.000.source: I'm going to go inside, I just wanted a quiet moment.
rain2.000.translation: Voi intra înăuntru, voiam doar un moment de liniște.
